03/26.03.2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P for the State.
2.

The Petitioner has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Sitaramdera P.S. Case No. 19 of 2024 corresponding to S.T. Case No.-514 of 2024, registered for the offences under Sections 376,313,342,348,504,506,509,34 of I.P.C and subsequently charges were framed under Sections 376(2)(n),313,342,348,504,506,509 of I.P.C 3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and there is love affair between the victim and the petitioner.
He further submits that out of seven charge-sheeted witnesses only two witnesses have been examined till date; as such, there is no likelihood of early conclusion of trial.
He further submits that the petitioner is having no criminal antecedent and he is in custody since 03.08.2024; as such, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
He lastly submits that the petitioner is ready to abide by every condition as imposed by this Court.
4. Learned A.P.P opposes the prayer for bail of the Petitioner.

sentences.text: Having regard to the facts of the case and looking to the allegation made against this petitioner,

2026:JHHC:8618 coupled with the fact that out of seven charge-sheeted witnesses only two witnesses have been examined till date; as such, there is no likelihood of early conclusion of trial and also the fact that the petitioner is languishing in custody since 03.08.2024; I am inclined to enlarge the Petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the above-named Petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Sessions Judge-III, Jamshedpur in connection with Sitaramdera P.S. Case No. 19 of 2024 corresponding to S.T. Case No.-514 of 2024.

6. It is made clear that the Petitioner shall appear on each and every date before the learned trial court and he shall not threaten any witness and shall co-operate in trial and if any adverse report will come against this Petitioner, learned trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of this Petitioner.
(Deepak Roshan, J.) 26th March, 2026 jk Uploaded on 30 /03/2026 Manish Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
